elfcat - ELF visualizer

elfcat generates an HTML report that helps you inspect ELF binaries. The report includes
hexdumps, section and segment information, and interactive visualizations to help you
understand the structure of ELF files.

Usage

  elfcat path/to/file

This will produce an HTML file (e.g. path/to/file.html) that you can open in a web browser.

Quick example

  # Generate a report and open it in your browser
  elfcat hello_world
  (opens hello_world.html)

Features

  * Generates human-readable HTML reports from ELF binaries
  * Interactive visualizations for sections, segments, and hexdumps
  * Helpful hover information and byte-level highlighting
